title: Offers & slow-selling stock
intro: Create product-wide discounts for all active variants. The best active offer wins; offers do not stack. Staff applies current offers to a saved draft in Billing before completing the sale.
staffOnly: Switch to Staff or Admin preview to manage offers.
storageError: Offer data could not be read or saved. Export a valid backup or restore/reset offers below.
deleteNote: Remove this offer? Saved bills and historical sales keep their already-saved prices.
slowNote: Active, sellable stock with gross units sold at or below your threshold during the selected trailing days. Age uses product creation date, not receipt age. Returns are not subtracted. New products can be excluded with minimum age. Demo dates may be old; adjust the range for your real data.
name: Offer title
dateNote: Dates include the whole selected day in Asia/Kolkata. Fixed discounts cannot reduce the price below zero.
invalid: Check product, title, dates and discount. Percentage must be a whole number from 1 to 90; fixed discount accepts up to two decimals. Storage must be available.
backupNote: Offer records are separate from the main shop and Style Studio backups. Keep all three backups together; restored product IDs must match. Main shop reset does not reset offers.
review: Backup validated. Review before replacing offers.
invalidBackup: Choose a valid offer backup below 500 KB (version 1).
count: {count} offer records will replace current offers.
resetNote: Remove all offer records? Existing sales and saved draft discounts remain unchanged.
